# UC33 — My mortgage

**Track:** foundations  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  
**OWASP:** 🛡️ **OWASP ASI** — Threats: T8, T9 · Sections: §4.1.1, §3.3.3, §8

## Buyer Story

Delegated-access proof can't be special-cased per tool — every account type the agent touches needs the same chain of custody, not just the everyday balance check.

## PingOne Solution

The same RFC 8693 delegated token (act={agent}) authorizes every tool call, including less-common products like a mortgage — one token exchange covers the whole tool surface.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Chip message: `show my mortgage`  
**Expected outcome:** `PERMIT`

## What to Say

> Same delegated token, a different tool — the act claim proves the agent all the way to a mortgage lookup, not just a balance check.

## Evidence

**Token chain steps:** user-token → token-exchange → authorize-decision → tool-dispatched  
**Activity categories:** token, authorize, mcp

- `demo_api_server/services/agentMcpTokenService.js`
